explanation:
### How it works

Move up-right on one diagonal and down-left on the next. After emitting a cell, advance in the current direction and correct any crossed matrix boundary, flipping direction. Carefully ordered boundary corrections handle rectangular matrices as well as squares.

### Steps

1. Start at the top-left cell moving up-right.
2. Emit each cell and advance diagonally.
3. Correct row/column overflow and switch direction until rows × columns values are emitted.

### Complexity

- Time: O(rows × columns).
- Space: O(rows × columns) output and O(1) extra workspace.

### Things to watch for

- The correction order matters when a move crosses two bounds.
- Check single-row and single-column matrices.
- The traversal visits cells, rather than sorting by their values.
